name: Ring of the Ram

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Ram
powers.text: 1 to 3 charges: a spectral ram's head strikes a creature within 60 ft (+7 to hit): 2d10 Force per charge and pushed 5 ft per charge.

summary: 3 charges: a spectral ram's head (+7 to hit) for 2d10 Force per charge that knocks the target back.
text: The ring holds 3 charges and regains 1d3 of them each dawn. Ram: as a Magic action, spend 1 to 3 charges and a ghostly ram's head makes a ranged spell attack, at +7 to hit, against a creature within 60 feet that you can see. For each charge spent, a hit deals 2d10 Force damage and pushes the target 5 feet away from you. Smash: as a Magic action, spend 1 to 3 charges to try to break an unattended object within 60 feet that you can see; the ring rolls a Strength check, adding +5 for each charge spent.
